apps.localizedDescription:
** [Description is only available in English currently] **
** App Still In Developement, Currently Support Google Login Only
=========== Let's Chat with Everyone! ===========
🌟Whats Good :
- ✨AI Summarize Messages
- 💬 Good UI (I am improving it now)
- 📘User’s Profile
- 🌎All Reigons Supported, Worldwide
- ⬆️ Uploading Large Files, Better Than Discord! (Need More Money, Please Donate To My Patreon)
- And More!
=========== Message Summarisation ===========
🤖 No API Needed! - Powered By Apple Intellgence, Supported Devices Only
📋 Summarisation With What You Want! - You Can Select Summarise All Messages, Selected Messages Only, Long Messages Only Or Off If You Want!
💻 Big LLM Platfroms API Supported! - If Your Device Does Not Support Apple Intellgence, You May Use You Own AI APIs!
🔐 Ai Privacy - Any Your Chat And Message Summarisation Won’t Be Sent To Me And Anyone
=========== Comparation ===========
Messages Summaration :
Discord ❌
Whatsapp ✅ (But Reigon Restricted)
LetsChat ✅ (Powered By Apple Intellgence, Custon APIs, All Reigon Supported)

NSFW, Content Blocking :
Discord ✅
Whatsapp ❌
LetsChat ✅ (Powered By Apple Sensitive Content Analysis Engine)

Customization :
Discord : ✅
Whatsapp 😑 (Chat only, Easy User Profile)
Letschat ✅ (Discord-Like User Profile, Full App Customization)

Group/Server Moderation :
Discord ✅ (Detail, Permission Moderation Good)
Whatsapp 👎 (No Detail Management, Just Easy Moderation Like Sending Messages And Invite Peoples)
LetsChat ✅ (Discord-Like, Detail)

AND MORE!
